concepts.label: SDK Data Structures API (Map/List/Queue/Set over a JSON document)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - no existing concept covers this high-level convenience layer. The page is explicit that Map/List/Queue/Set are built ON TOP of existing document access ('These data structures are stored as JSON documents... can therefore be accessed using SQL++, Full Text Search, and normal key-value operations... can also be manipulated using the traditional sub-document and full-document KV APIs'), so it is a distinct, higher-level concept from sdk:kv-operations and sdk:subdocument-operations, not a synonym for either.

concepts.label: CouchbaseMap (java.util.Map-backed wrapper over a document)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a specific, named implementation class the page walks through in detail (2-subdocument-request put/remove semantics, casMismatchRetries), distinct enough from the general Data Structures API description to warrant its own id.

concepts.label: key-value operations
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - the page states data structures 'can also be manipulated using the traditional sub-document and full-document KV APIs', i.e. full-document KV is one of the two underlying mechanisms; reusing the already-promoted concept rather than minting a duplicate.

concepts.label: Sub-document operations (lookupIn/mutateIn)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - the page names the Sub-Document API twice as the other underlying mechanism behind the Data Structures API and behind CouchbaseMap specifically.

relations.subject: sdk:couchbase-map
relations.evidence: CouchbaseMap needs to make at least 2 subdocument requests: one request to get the current value, and a second request to update it.

relations.subject: sdk:couchbase-map
relations.evidence: If you need to feed a Couchbase document to an existing API that only works with `java.util.Map`, then CouchbaseMap may be a quick way to get started with tackling the task without delving into the [Sub-Document API](subdocument-operations.md).

notable_absence.finding: The page never version-gates the Data Structures API or CouchbaseMap at all (unlike sibling concept-docs pages such as collections.md and buckets-and-clusters.md, which explicitly call out Server 7.x support). No availableSince relation could be extracted for this page's own concepts.

cross_component_finding: This is the batch's first direct test of the round's central hypothesis (does concept-docs describe the SAME thing as howtos, or something new?), and the answer here is a clean split: the page's HEADLINE concept (the Data Structures API / CouchbaseMap) is genuinely new - it's a convenience layer never mentioned in round 3/4's howto extractions of kv-operations.md or subdocument-operations.md - but the page is explicit that this new layer is built entirely out of the two already-promoted mechanisms sdk:kv-operations and sdk:subdocument-operations, naming both directly ('the traditional sub-document and full-document KV APIs'). So I minted two new concepts for the layer itself, but reused rather than re-minted for its foundations, which is exactly the reuse-vs-mint distinction this round asked to watch for.
